text_block_list.text:
And then came week one of summer training 
camp.

Amidst various temptations like the beach, 
mountains, and festivals, Mayano Top Gun—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, Maya. Hasn't she gotten completely 
faster?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
With this, she's number one among this 
year's Umamusume! No, more like number one 
among all Umamusume, right?
choice_data_list: Isn't that taking it a bit too far?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "I don't care! I'm gonna say it!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya has to make Trainer-chan say that 
"Maya sparkles the brightest"!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: What I saw that day—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: —Even more than Brian-san.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no no no! Trainer-chan, you're not 
allowed to say that name!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Jeez, you really never let your guard 
down, do you!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, why am I still in the Classic year? 
The moment I become a Senior, I'm gonna 
take on Brian-san right away—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ah!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan. What races are left on the 
Triple Crown route?

—The Classic Triple Crown route. It is the 
very path Narita Brian took to become a 
Triple Crown Umamusume.

Now that the spring Satsuki Sho and 
Japanese Derby are over, the final race on 
the Triple Crown path is...
choice_data_list: We still have the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Okey-dokey☆ So that's our next target, 
huh!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'll put on a run that's way more exciting 
than even Brian-san's!
choice_data_list: You're really fired up, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Nihihi☆ You think so~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You don't dislike a fired-up Maya either, 
do you~? Right?♪

"And so, she set her sights on a new goal: 
the Kikuka Sho—!"
